title: Derived-unit homology map agrees with classical derived pullback
statement: Let $X,X^{\prime}$ be schemes [def-pc-scheme], $g:X^{\prime}\to X$ a morphism, $G$ an abelian sheaf on $X_{\mathrm{et}}$ [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves], and $q\in\mathbb N$. Set $K=G[0]$ [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], $L=g^{-1}$ [def-weil-pbc-derived-inverse-image], $\Gamma=\Gamma(X,-)$, $\Gamma^{\prime}=\Gamma(X^{\prime},-)$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology], $P=R^+\Gamma$ and $P^{\prime}=R^+\Gamma^{\prime}$. Let $p=H^q(P(\eta_K);\lambda_{LK})$ be the derived-unit and Leray pullback [lem-weil-pbc-cohomology-pullback-derived-unit]. Let $a:H^q(P^{\prime}(LK))\xrightarrow{\sim}H^q(P^{\prime}((LG)[0]))$ be induced by the canonical exact-functor/single-complex isomorphism. Let $c_G:H^q(P(G[0]))\xrightarrow{\sim}R^q\Gamma(G)$ and $c^{\prime}_{LG}$ be the canonical classical single-complex comparisons. Let $e:\Gamma\to L\Gamma^{\prime}$ be the underived section map from the unit and the direct-image/global-sections isomorphism. Then $p;a;c^{\prime}_{LG}=c_G;\operatorname{rightDerivedBaseChange}(e,q)_G$.

source.place: Cohomology, Lemma 01F8 (lemma-functoriality), equations 01F9 (equation-functorial-derived) and 01FA (equation-functorial), Remark 01FB (remark-explain-arrow); sites-cohomology.tex Remark 08J6 for the site version.

proof.text: Use total derived unit/base-change coherence at the single complex G[0].
Rewrite rightDerivedBaseChange_app, cancel the single-complex comparison, and use the identity-derived homology comparison. Functoriality of homology and associativity finish.

proof_origin.place: Equations 01F9 and 01FA; explicit canonical coherence reduction.

theorem derivedUnit_classicalPullback {X X' : Scheme.{u}} (g' : X' ⟶ X)
    (G : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) (q : ℕ) :
    let K := (DerivedCategory.Plus.singleFunctor _ 0).obj G
    let P := (Sheaf.Γ X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}).rightDerivedFunctorPlus
    let P' := (Sheaf.Γ X'.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}).rightDerivedFunctorPlus
    let p := (DerivedCategory.Plus.homologyFunctor _ (q : ℤ)).map
      (P.map ((upperStarLowerStarAdjunction AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} g').derivedPlus.unit.app K) ≫
        (@Functor.rightDerivedFunctorPlusCompIso' _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _
          (lowerStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} g')
          (Sheaf.Γ X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) _ _ _ _
          (Functor.preservesInjectiveObjects_of_adjunction_of_preservesMonomorphisms
            (upperStarLowerStarAdjunction AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} g'))
          (lowerStarCompGlobalSectionsIso AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} g')).hom.app
            (((g')^*[AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}]).mapDerivedCategoryPlus.obj K))
    let Γ := Sheaf.Γ X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
    let Γ' := Sheaf.Γ X'.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
    let L := upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} g'
    let e : Γ ⋙ 𝟭 _ ⟶ L ⋙ Γ' :=
      (Functor.rightUnitor Γ).hom ≫ (Functor.leftUnitor Γ).inv ≫
        Functor.whiskerRight (upperStarLowerStarAdjunction AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} g').unit Γ ≫
        (Functor.associator _ _ _).hom ≫
        Functor.whiskerLeft L (lowerStarCompGlobalSectionsIso AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} g').hom
    p ≫ (DerivedCategory.Plus.homologyFunctor _ (q : ℤ)).map
        (P'.map ((L.mapDerivedCategoryPlusSingleFunctor 0).hom.app G)) ≫
        (Γ'.singleFunctorCompRightDerivedFunctorPlusCompHomologyFunctorIso q).hom.app
          (L.obj G) =
      (Γ.singleFunctorCompRightDerivedFunctorPlusCompHomologyFunctorIso q).hom.app G ≫
        (Functor.rightDerivedBaseChange e q).app G
